subject.title: fix(codex): prefer recovered replies over stale failure banners

question: Should failed Codex turns be allowed to resolve from partial streamed assistant deltas when no completed assistant message was emitted?
rationale: The source review shows this PR changes message-delivery semantics beyond completed recovered replies, and accepting partial progress as a user-visible answer is a maintainer product decision.

options.title: Require Completed Assistant Evidence
options.body: Suppress failed-turn errors only when completed assistant-message data exists, preserving failures for partial-delta-only turns.

options.title: Accept Partial Delta Delivery
options.body: Allow partial deltas to replace failure banners, but make that choice explicit and require live proof for incomplete-output handling.

options.title: Pause For Codex Contract Clarification
options.body: Wait for upstream Codex to expose a clearer recovered-versus-fatal completion signal before changing delivery behavior.

recommendation.title: Require Completed Assistant Evidence
recommendation.body: Suppress failed-turn errors only when completed assistant-message data exists, preserving failures for partial-delta-only turns.
